MCP server for AI agents that need a phone number: order a private number in 200+ countries, read the SMS verification code, hand it back. The widest country coverage in the category, and you can check it with one API call.
600 行 TypeScript 写成的超级迷你版 pi，让你轻松从 0 写出属于你的 pi-agent
Make your agents talk human. ADHD-friendly output styles for Claude Code. So you can pay attention, not tokens.
A skill to kill from-scratch coding — Claude checks real arXiv prior art before it designs a new architecture.
AI 短剧制作的 skill 集合：拆角色、出设定图、排大纲 | Agent skills for AI short-drama production — character bibles, model sheets, adaptation outlines. Runs in Claude Code & codex.
Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.

The long-horizon computer-use harness. Run AI agents across desktop apps and the CLI for extended periods while preserving task state and making reliable progress on complex workflows. Features fresh-context execution, durable verified state, independent auditing, recoverable progress, and native Claude Code / Codex / OpenClaw integration.
Source-backed architecture notes on building an agent
